name: muscle resting membrane potential
notes: whole-cell body-wall muscle recording; rest sits close to the AP threshold

name: muscle AP amplitude
notes: all-or-none; overshoot about +20 mV; slow rise fast fall

name: muscle AP half-width
notes: one of the main tau_m anchors: the paper reports no input resistance/membrane time constant

name: spontaneous bursting (myogenic)
notes: slow-wave lead-in <10 mV; persists after NMJ blockade

name: hyperpolarisation firing-stop threshold
notes: frequency extremely sensitive to membrane potential = direct evidence of a frequency-modulation mechanism

name: channel division of labour
value: EGL-19 required; CCA-1 contributes; SHK-1+SLO-2 repolarise; SLO-2 sets rest
notes: Ca transient requires EGL-19+UNC-68 (RyR); one Ca peak often corresponds to a burst of APs

name: tonic GABA inhibition
notes: resting potential falls after NMJ blockade -> tonic GABA input exists

name: membrane time-constant design anchor
notes: Liu 2011 has no input-resistance data; pinned by AP half-width 20ms + contraction timing + calibration probes

name: single-AP-driven contraction
notes: temporal lower bound of muscle excitation-contraction coupling

name: AP-count vs postsynaptic-current relation
notes: quantitative anchor of frequency coding; calibration probes benchmark directly against this curve

name: synaptic reversal potentials
notes: rest sits between the two -> dual excitatory/inhibitory modulation; basis for the GABA negative-sign design

name: GABA blockade effect
value: fully reversible block of AP + relaxation
notes: behavioural-level validation anchor of the VD/DD relaxation branch

name: fraction of spontaneous APs blocked by dTBC
notes: the remaining ~12% is myogenic residue

name: muscle-wave vs curvature-wave phase lag (low viscosity)
notes: buffer/1%MC: elasticity-dominated regime

name: phase lag (high viscosity/agar)
value: accumulates along the mid-body; local lead at head/tail
notes: signature of the drag-dominated regime; environment-switch criterion for calibration probes

name: wavenumber relation
notes: frequency locked everywhere; the lag comes from a wavenumber difference not a frequency difference

name: GCaMP kinetic delay
notes: only relative lags may be used; must be declared in the paper

name: muscle-torque vs curvature phase difference (crawling)
notes: model-predicted value; torque and curvature are in phase during swimming

name: dorsal/ventral muscle contraction phase
notes: VD/DD Ca signals fall during contraction of the corresponding muscle

name: crawling curvature amplitude (normalised)
notes: Stephens is in normalised units without absolute values; to be cross-validated by C3.6

name: omega/delta turn peak amplitude
notes: lowest self-touch values; upper bound for turn-amplitude calibration

name: escape reorientation angle
notes: literature source of the single-turn >90 deg hard criterion

name: local-curvature biomechanical cap
notes: tangent-angle difference ≤1.95 rad within 0.1L; prevents numerical over-bending

name: eigenmode tracking bounds
notes: eigenworm mode-amplitude caps

name: swim/crawl wavelength-frequency-curvature absolute values
notes: the DASH manuscript version (PDF archived in refs_pdf) lacks in-table values; the PNAS final Table 1 is needed; Fig 3a-c trend plots can be digitised

name: body-wall bending elasticity coefficient
notes: relaxation-viscosity slope; verified against the full text

name: body-wall internal viscosity coefficient
notes: upper bound; internal elastic force ~100x internal viscous force -> negligible in the model

name: attack-angle peak
notes: approximately constant across viscosity 1→28000 mPa·s; thrust-conservation criterion

name: total muscle-power stability
notes: external viscous dissipation varies ~1000×; constant power = the purpose of gait adaptation

name: thin-chamber drag correction
notes: settling speed bulk 0.66±0.04 vs thin 0.068±0.007 mm/s (N=10)

name: relaxation scaling law
notes: lowest-mode relaxation of a viscoelastic rod; used to calibrate environment stiffness

name: head-group muscle (rows 01-06) innervation
notes: unit = EM contact count; specialised head muscle group

name: body-group muscle (rows 07-24) innervation
notes: dorsoventral quadrant grouping = the new muscle-layer grouping skeleton

name: GABA crossed innervation
notes: crossed fingerprint complete; wiring basis of the relaxation branch

name: head-group amplitude peptidergic knob
value: SMB release; mutants show increased body-bend amplitude
notes: peptidergic output of SMB the head-group innervator; candidate for the v82 head-group gain interface

name: peptides acting directly on muscle channels
value: FLP-1-6 open Cl channels; FLP-6 ventral-contract dorsal-relax; FLP-8/14 biphasic rhythm
notes: evidence from a close nematode relative; direct peptide receptors on C. elegans muscle unconfirmed

name: NMJ presynaptic peptidergic modulation (ACh)
notes: NMJ peptidergic modulation is widespread; one basis of the pep/g_tot mechanism
